purpose: Permit a private, serial preparation plan only after one exact inactive body candidate passes the single-body objective and independent rendered-visual gates.
truth_note: A one-body pass may unlock only a content-addressed, dry-run plan of private reference-audit and candidate-preparation work, one job at a time. It cannot approve, activate, replace, export, release, or satisfy the separate two-distinct-subject gate. Every later candidate retains its exact identity, version, maturity, topology, privacy, evidence, and owner-review requirements.
